integrity: All mathematical claims have an analytic proof. A finite exact-rational and floating point checker supplements, but cannot replace, the universal proof; no priority or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only undirected simple wheels, linear edge-orbit prices, sum of all pair effective resistances. The equal-price wheel solution and general convexity are prior results. No independent verification has occurred.
title: The sharp rim-price deletion transition and singular limits for resistance-optimal wheels
